gs-lakatos.title: Imre Lakatos, Proofs and Refutations: The Logic of Mathematical Discovery (1976), Cambridge University Press
gs-lakatos.notes: Book description verifies author, title, method and publication context.

gs-lakatos-appendix.title: Imre Lakatos, Another case-study in the method of proofs and refutations, appendix
gs-lakatos-appendix.notes: Accessible summary describes primitive conjectures, global counterexamples, analysis of proof, and revised claims.

gs-simpson-sep.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Simpson's Paradox (revised 2026)
gs-simpson-sep.notes: Mathematical characterization, aggregation and the causal interpretation limits.

gs-maintainers-aeon.title: Andrew Russell and Lee Vinsel, Hail the Maintainers, Aeon (7 April 2016)
gs-maintainers-aeon.notes: Normative historical argument against treating innovation as an end in itself.

gs-maintainers-about.title: The Maintainers, About / project history
gs-maintainers-about.notes: Independent project history verifies the 2016 essay and context.

gs-nasa-rogers.title: Rogers Commission Report on Challenger, Volume I, Chapter VI, Findings
gs-nasa-rogers.notes: Primary investigation on SRB joint failures, response to warnings and acceptance of risk.

gs-truthfulqa.title: Stephanie Lin, Jacob Hilton, Owain Evans, TruthfulQA: Measuring How Models Mimic Human Falsehoods, ACL 2022
gs-truthfulqa.notes: Original 2022 paper; the essay does not generalize historical model scores to contemporary systems.

gs-nist-gai.title: NIST, Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile, AI 600-1 (2024)
gs-nist-gai.notes: Sections on confabulation, automation bias, and information integrity.

gs-nist-rmf.title: NIST, Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0, AI 100-1 (2023)
gs-nist-rmf.notes: Framework for context-specific AI reliability, accountability and trustworthiness.

gs-goodhart-2006.title: Charles A. E. Goodhart, The ECB and the Conduct of Monetary Policy: Goodhart's Law and Lessons from the Euro Area, Journal of Common Market Studies (2006)
gs-goodhart-2006.notes: Author restates the 1975 formulation and discusses its monetary-policy origins.

gs-campbell-1976.title: Donald T. Campbell, Assessing the Impact of Planned Social Change, Occasional Paper Series #8 (December 1976)
gs-campbell-1976.notes: Bibliographic record of the original occasional-paper issue. Later journal republication appeared in 1979; original essay first appeared in 1975.

gs-campbell-1979.title: Donald T. Campbell, Assessing the Impact of Planned Social Change, Evaluation and Program Planning 2(1), 67-90 (1979)
gs-campbell-1979.notes: Journal publication with accessible publisher abstract and explicit note that material was reprinted from 1975.

gs-goodhart-vs-campbell.title: Jeffery Rodamar, There Ought to Be a Law! Campbell versus Goodhart, Significance 15(6), p. 9 (2018)
gs-goodhart-vs-campbell.notes: Historical comparison of Goodhart/Campbell ideas; attributes the generalized modern slogan separately.

gs-strathern-1997.title: Marilyn Strathern, Improving Ratings: Audit in the British University System, European Review 5(3), 305-321 (1997)
gs-strathern-1997.notes: Modern aphoristic formulation of Goodhart-style failure; acknowledges prior discussion by Keith Hoskin.

gs-wells-cfpb-2016.title: CFPB, Wells Fargo $100 Million Penalty for Unauthorized Accounts (September 8, 2016)
gs-wells-cfpb-2016.notes: Regulator names incentives and sales targets, over 2 million potentially unauthorized accounts, and CFPB penalty amount. Do not treat potentially unauthorized as proven count.

gs-amateur-etymology.title: Merriam-Webster, amateur, etymology
gs-amateur-etymology.notes: Latin amator via French; occupational distinction.

gs-amateurs-professionals-history.title: David E. Allen, Amateurs and Professionals, The Cambridge History of Science, Volume 6 (2009)
gs-amateurs-professionals-history.notes: Chapter summary discusses professionalization of nineteenth-century science and caution about historical categories; full chapter not required for the assertions made.

gs-hanny-nasa.title: NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day, What is Hanny's Voorwerp? (June 25, 2008)
gs-hanny-nasa.notes: Discovery of object in Galaxy Zoo by Hanny van Arkel, and professional follow-up observations.

gs-hanny-retrospective.title: Hanny van Arkel, Hanny's Voorwerp, The story behind (November 2008)
gs-hanny-retrospective.notes: Discoverer's retrospective account of the August 2007 observation.

gs-galaxyzoo-results.title: Galaxy Zoo / Zooniverse, Results, The Story So Far
gs-galaxyzoo-results.notes: Project dates and deliberately repeated galaxy classifications to test reliability.

gs-nws-observations.title: NOAA National Weather Service, Observations (CoCoRaHS and Cooperative Observer Program)
gs-nws-observations.notes: Standards, training, purposes, and scientific uses of volunteer weather observations.

gs-nasem-citizen-science.title: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine, Learning Through Citizen Science: Enhancing Opportunities by Design (2018)
gs-nasem-citizen-science.notes: Research synthesis on participant learning and citizen science design.

gs-citizen-science-quality.title: Seven Primary Data Types in Citizen Science Determine Data Quality Requirements and Methods, Frontiers in Climate (2021)
gs-citizen-science-quality.notes: Comparison of citizen data types, validation methods, and observer-error concerns.

gs-sandcastle-aristotle.title: Aristotle, Nicomachean Ethics, Book I, Chapter 1, 1094a (trans. H. Rackham, 1926), Perseus Digital Library
gs-sandcastle-aristotle.notes: Book I opening distinguishes some ends as activities and others as separate products. This does not license a general claim that Aristotle always privileged the process.

gs-sandcastle-sep-intrinsic.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Intrinsic vs. Extrinsic Value (revised June 2, 2025)
gs-sandcastle-sep-intrinsic.notes: Distinguishes intrinsic/extrinsic value, and discusses philosophical disputes over intrinsic, final, and instrumental value.

gs-sandcastle-sep-meaning.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, The Meaning of Life
gs-sandcastle-sep-meaning.notes: Contemporary survey distinguishing meaningfulness from happiness and moral rightness; no single theory is presented as settled.

gs-sandcastle-gray-play.title: Peter Gray, Definitions of Play, Scholarpedia 8(7):30578 (2013)
gs-sandcastle-gray-play.notes: Describes multiple influential definitions of play, including motive, freedom, rules, and activity framed by participants.

gs-credit-edison-rutgers.title: Thomas A. Edison Papers (Rutgers University), Invention Factory: Expanding the Laboratory
gs-credit-edison-rutgers.notes: Describes Menlo Park staffing, hiring and roles, including growth to 50-60 workers during lighting development.

gs-credit-edison-nps.title: National Park Service historical handbook, Beehives of Invention: Edison and His Laboratories, Edisons Top Assistants
gs-credit-edison-nps.notes: Summarizes the skills of Charles Batchelor, John Kruesi and Francis Upton, quoting retrospective recollections.

gs-credit-leavitt-harvard.title: Harvard Plate Stacks (Center for Astrophysics | Harvard & Smithsonian), Henrietta Swan Leavitt
gs-credit-leavitt-harvard.notes: Biographical account of Leavitt, Harvard women computers, and her work on Magellanic Cloud variables.

gs-credit-leavitt-variables.title: Harvard Plate Stacks, Variable Stars
gs-credit-leavitt-variables.notes: Explains period-luminosity relation, initial sample and later calibration, plus the standard-candle application.

gs-credit-leavitt-paper.title: Henrietta S. Leavitt (prepared), Periods of 25 Variable Stars in the Small Magellanic Cloud, Harvard College Observatory Circular 173 (1912)
gs-credit-leavitt-paper.notes: Primary-publication pointer. The substantive historical claims were checked against Harvard Plate Stacks rather than relying on a secondary transcription of the scanned circular.

gs-credit-smallpox-who-overview.title: World Health Organization, Smallpox overview
gs-credit-smallpox-who-overview.notes: Intensified effort started 1967, final natural case 1977, 1980 World Health Assembly recognition; Jenner 1796 background.

gs-credit-smallpox-who-statue.title: World Health Organization, Statue commemorates smallpox eradication (May 17, 2010)
gs-credit-smallpox-who-statue.notes: Detailed chronology, surveillance and containment, case identification, outreach and adaptation by local and field workers.

gs-credit-smallpox-who-40.title: World Health Organization, Commemorating the 40th Anniversary of Smallpox Eradication (May 8, 2020)
gs-credit-smallpox-who-40.notes: Separates 1979 Global Commission certification from May 1980 World Health Assembly endorsement.

gs-credit-merton.title: Robert K. Merton, The Matthew Effect in Science, Science 159, 56–63 (1968)
gs-credit-merton.notes: Original articulation of Matthew effect in disproportionate credit for eminent scientists.

gs-credit-rossiter.title: Margaret W. Rossiter, The Matthew Matilda Effect in Science, Social Studies of Science 23, 325–341 (1993)
gs-credit-rossiter.notes: Introduces Matilda effect and names Matilda Joslyn Gage as the historical feminist critic.
